title: Harborview pilot financial and technical audit (synthetic fixture)
text: This audit reviews the Harborview Tidal Pilot after three years of operation. The audit records the installed capacity of the Harborview Tidal Pilot as 15 megawatts. The total construction cost of the pilot was 96 million dollars according to the audited accounts. The pilot uses six turbines. The pilot does not require dredging of the shipping channel.
